summary: Sentra generated operating context, Hermes consumed the promotion input, a promotion decision was produced, and the operating ledger linked the cycle artifacts.

outcomes.summary: Sentra context now produces a snapshot and promotion input from projects, decisions, reviews, and priorities.
Hermes promotion workflow consumed Sentra input and produced auditable promotion artifacts.
Sentra ledger links operating events to snapshot and promotion artifacts.

risks.summary: Autonomy without tight gates could create unsafe repo changes
Execution agents may overfit to terminal scripting instead of durable workflows
Premature full autonomy before patch/test/report boundaries are stable

nextPriorities.title: Promotion Ledger Multi-Source
nextPriorities.why: The promotion history ledger only reads the single hardcoded hermes-promotion-v1.json artifact, so it would silently miss any future Hermes promotion workflow version.
nextPriorities.desiredOutcome: Generalize the ledger writer to discover and append events from every Hermes promotion artifact, not just hermes-promotion-v1.json.

nextPriorities.title: Hermes Agentic Workflow Run Closeout
nextPriorities.why: Multi-project prioritization selected Hermes Agentic Workflow as the top project, but its run-v4 PR lifecycle has been tracking-ready with no branch, push, or PR across multiple cycles, and no closeout artifact has been produced.
nextPriorities.desiredOutcome: Produce the proposed post-merge ledger (or an explicit closeout decision) for run-v4 so the top-priority project stops stalling.

ledgerEvents.summary: Mastra promoted for controlled Hermes orchestration use.

notes: This review is generated from operating artifacts on every run.
